'''Sherro''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], at which [[Time/Legends|time]] Sherro led a resistance cell against the Imperial occupation. [[Havoc Squad]] linked up Sherro's cell with [[Hendrick]]'s and [[Oudon]]'s, and the group set up an ambush in a [[Celestial Industries factory|factory]] in the [[Labor Valley]] that wiped out a large number of Imperials.<ref name="TOR" />
